'''Pychor Vuundir''' was [[king]] of the [[planet]] [[Vuundalla]]. He ruled over the planet with his wife, [[Queen]] [[Dafne Vuundir]]. The two leaders were generally apathetic towards their people, but interested in wider [[The galaxy|galactic]] politics, particularly in [[Starlight Beacon]]. He was the [[Parent|father]] of [[Prince]] [[Cyrus Vuundir]], and was unaware of his alter ego as the [[pirate]] Taborr Val Dorn. Following a [[groundquake]] on Vuundalla, he was convinced by Cyrus to allow supplies intended to rebuild his family's secondary [[fathier]] stable to be used for rebuilding efforts in the [[City|village]] near the palace. Pychor Vuundir was present at the [[Dedication of the Starlight Beacon|dedication of Starlight Beacon]].<ref name="Aftershock" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Pychor Vuundir first appeared in the final batch of [[Young Jedi Adventures Season One|season one]] episodes of ''[[Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures]]'', including the season one finale. He was voiced by [[Noshir Dalal]], who performed alongside his wife, [[Sharon Muthu]], who voiced Queen Dafne.<ref name="Aftershock" />
